PRIVACY_POLICY.TITLE: Privacy Policy
PRIVACY_POLICY.SECTION_1_CONTENT: When you log in with Facebook, we collect your public name and profile photo. We also collect your email address to create your CochaVive account.
PRIVACY_POLICY.SECTION_2_CONTENT: We use your information solely to create and manage your CochaVive account and to show you relevant events in Cochabamba, Bolivia.
PRIVACY_POLICY.SECTION_3_CONTENT: We do not sell or share your personal information with third parties.
PRIVACY_POLICY.SECTION_4_CONTENT: You can request deletion of your data by contacting us at gforce4182@gmail.com.
PRIVACY_POLICY.SECTION_5_CONTENT: For any privacy-related questions, write to us at gforce4182@gmail.com.
